component.name: DROP
component.summary: Send files and folders across your local network
Передача файлов и папок по локальной сети

description.p: DROP sends files and folders between Linux, Windows, macOS and Android devices on the same trusted local network. Files arrive automatically in the folder you choose.
DROP передаёт файлы и папки между Linux, Windows, macOS и Android в одной доверенной локальной сети. Файлы принимаются автоматически в выбранную папку.

ul.li: Folders keep their structure, including empty folders
Direct TCP between devices, no cloud
Pause, resume and automatic recovery after a lost connection
Runs in the background with a tray icon

description.p: Data on the local network is not encrypted. Use DROP only on networks you trust.
